}

    DRAFT / 'manifest.json': '1516d127a688cea5e5a707fbc562e0e70cd43fcd583752be25b1cc3871d95502',
    DRAFT / 'handoff.json': '970299f1be40510c16eb2c707be39a947023e0eaf80f87f924ea057ea79324df',
    DRAFT / 'open-issues.json': '9cae43f9c0a1d30e1388eced5e902fc81c91150474ce6076cc2911ae0f3d1ea8',

def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def load(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))


def record(path):
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    return {'path': path.as_posix(), 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': sha(raw)}


def git(*args, raw=False):
    data = subprocess.check_output(['git', '--no-optional-locks', '-C', REPO.as_posix(), *args])
    return data if raw else data.decode('utf-8').strip()


def write_new(path, data):
    with path.open('xb') as out:
        out.write((json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8'))


assert not (OWN / 'verification.json').exists()
assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD') == BASE
assert git('branch', '--show-current') == 'ci/entwicklungspruefung'
assert not git('status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all')
remote = dict(line.split()[::-1] for line in git('ls-remote', '--heads', 'origin', 'refs/heads/main', 'refs/heads/ci/entwicklungspruefung').splitlines())
assert remote == {'refs/heads/main': MAIN, 'refs/heads/ci/entwicklungspruefung': BASE}
for path, expected in REQUIRED.items():
    assert record(path)['sha256'] == expected, str(path)
handoff = load(DRAFT / 'handoff.json')
assert len(handoff['files']) == handoff['hashedFileCount']
assert len({e['path'] for e in handoff['files']}) == len(handoff['files'])
for entry in handoff['files']:
    actual = record(DRAFT / entry['path'])
    assert (actual['sha256'], actual['bytes']) == (entry['sha256'], entry['bytes']), entry['path']
prior = Path('F:/ChnobelRuntime/verification/anchor-consultation-02/verification.json')
assert record(prior)['sha256'] == 'fa35b7a6297e24d8dd35565d2c99ef0e1fba55dd37c27feca972b18a86da7c70'
for batch in ('deleg_6aa0a185', 'deleg_f0606d8f'):
    bm = load(Path('C:/Users/user/AppData/Local/hermes/cache/delegation/live') / batch / 'manifest.json')
    assert bm['task_count'] == len(bm['tasks']) == 2
    assert all(t['status'] == t['exit_reason'] == 'completed' for t in bm['tasks'])

roles = []
for role, (rhash, dhash, recommendation) in EXPECTED_ROLES.items():
    rp, dp = ANCHOR / role / 'report.md', ANCHOR / role / 'decision.json'
    assert record(rp)['sha256'] == rhash and record(dp)['sha256'] == dhash
    d = load(dp)
    assert d['role'] == role and d['scopeStatus'] == 'COMPLETE'
    assert d['questionId'] == 'Q-ANCHOR-INTERVENTION'
    assert d['wholeManifestVerdict'] == 'NOT_ISSUED' and d['wholeRoleStatus'] == 'INCOMPLETE_OTHER_QUESTIONS_PENDING'
    assert d['normativeClassification'] == 'PROSPECTIVE_CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED'
    assert d['recommendation'] == recommendation and not d['implementationAuthorized'] and not d['ratificationIssued']
    assert d['reportSha256'] == rhash and len(d['counterexamples']) == 3
    roles.append({'role': role, 'report': record(rp), 'decision': record(dp), 'scopeStatus': d['scopeStatus'], 'recommendation': recommendation})

r = load(ANCHOR / 'redteam/decision.json')
sources_path = ANCHOR / 'redteam/sources.json'
assert record(sources_path)['sha256'] == 'ece02876402de1bfa6f932ed1fa297906a65c2596830947e6952316034c09ca4'
sources = load(sources_path)
assert r['sourceBindingDetails']['sha256'] == record(sources_path)['sha256']
assert len(r['sourceBindings']) == len(sources['sourceBindings'])
assert len({x['path'] for x in r['sourceBindings']}) == len(r['sourceBindings'])
assert {x['path']: x for x in r['sourceBindings']} == {
    x['path']: {'path': x['path'], 'sha256': x['afterSha256'], 'kind': x['kind']}
    for x in sources['sourceBindings']
}
assert len(sources['sourceBindings']) == sources['sourceCount']
assert len({x['path'] for x in sources['sourceBindings']}) == sources['sourceCount']
immutable = 0
mutable = []
for row in sources['sourceBindings']:
    path = Path(row['path'])
    assert record(path)['sha256'] == row['afterSha256'], str(path)
    if path in MUTABLE:
        rel = path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix()
        old = git('show', PREVIOUS + ':' + rel, raw=True)
        new = git('show', BASE + ':' + rel, raw=True)
        variants = lambda b: {sha(b), sha(b.replace(b'\r\n', b'\n').replace(b'\n', b'\r\n'))}
        assert row['beforeSha256'] in variants(old) and row['afterSha256'] in variants(new)
        diff = git('diff', PREVIOUS, BASE, '--', rel, raw=True)
        mutable.append({'path': path.as_posix(), 'beforeSha256': row['beforeSha256'], 'afterSha256': row['afterSha256'], 'parentCommitBefore': PREVIOUS, 'parentCommitAfter': BASE, 'exactGitDiffSha256': sha(diff)})
    else:
        assert row['beforeSha256'] == row['afterSha256'] and row['unchanged']
        immutable += 1
assert len(mutable) == len(MUTABLE)
assert r['inputBindingsBefore'] == r['inputBindingsAfter']
for row in r['inputBindingsBefore']:
    assert record(Path(row['path']))['sha256'] == row['sha256']
case_index = {c['id']: c for c in load(DRAFT / 'case-index-base.json')}
assert {c['id'] for c in r['cases']} == CASE_IDS
reference_checks = 0
for case in r['cases']:
    original = case_index[case['id']]
    assert original['oracleStatus'] == case['currentSpecificationStatus'] == 'SPECIFICATION_PENDING'
    for kind in ('input', 'oracle'):
        assert case[kind] == original[kind]
    doc = load(DRAFT / case['input']['path'])
    events = {e['seq']: e for e in doc['events']}
    text = (ANCHOR / 'redteam/report.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    for event in events.values():
        assert event['eventId'] in text
        reference_checks += 1
    w = case['witness']
    mapping = {'historicalChildEventId': w['historicalFreeAnchorSeq'], 'newChildReturnEventId': w['newChildAnchorSeq'], 'appUndoEventId': w['completeEffectivenessSeq'], 'targetHintEventId': w['targetHintSeq'], 'resultEventId': 8}
    for key, seq in mapping.items():
        assert w[key] == events[seq]['eventId']
    assert events[w['newChildAnchorSeq']]['actor'] == w['newChildAnchorActor'] == 'child'
    assert events[w['completeEffectivenessSeq']]['actor'] == w['effectivenessActor'] == 'app'
    assert events[w['submittedSeq']]['type'] == 'attempt.closed'
    assert w['historicalGuidedUsesBothSeqs'] == [5, 6] and w['completeHistoricalGuidedEvidenceFromSeq'] == 6
    hist = case['historicalSource']
    assert record(Path(hist['path']))['sha256'] == hist['sha256'] == record(DRAFT / hist['archived'])['sha256']
for c in r['counterexamples']:
    assert c['caseId'] in case_index
assert {c['kind'] for c in r['counterexamples']} == {'positive', 'negative', 'unclear'}
assert not any(r['independence'].values())

    if p is not None:

    if node['decision'] == 'RETAIN':

assert all(n['references'][0]['chosenTarget'] is None for n in blocked)
assert ndoc['counts']['documentNodes'] == len(nodes)
assert ndoc['counts']['historicalSelectedNodes'] == len(base_nodes)

command = ['F:/ChnobelRuntime/venv/Scripts/python.exe', '-B', str(EVENT / 'mechanics/check_documents.py'), 'readback']
